environment.description: ECS Fargate task running the container with default awsvpc networking. Task role has s3:GetObject on the reports bucket. Container runs as root (default Fargate behavior when Dockerfile has no USER directive). No seccomp or AppArmor profile applied. Service is behind an ALB with no WAF attached, exposed to internal VPC CIDR 10.0.0.0/16.

config.network: ALB -> target group, no WAF, internal-facing
